ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white/grey) pixels; estimated macro-ratio of 1:18.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous grey circular blobs mapped in a horizontal line across the mid-section of the left lobe; a cluster of overlapping grey blobs on the outer third of the right lobe; white irregular masses at the distal-most points of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal vertex angle of 105 degrees and a high pixel-depth relative to the adjacent trailing edge peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels; notable deep indentation (~15 pixels) located on the distal half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave trailing edge curve transitioning from the central notch to a strong posterior sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left lobe: horizontal linear constellation of 6 circular grey clusters between 30% and 70% span. Right lobe: clustered constellation of 4-5 overlapping circular marks at 80% span.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white/light-grey scarring and calcified material covering the distal 10% of both fluke tips; several small high-intensity punctate marks scattered near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive linear alignment of circular rosette marks on the left lobe, creating a 'beaded' visual pattern.
